dna.combo: a climbing route as the content plan (hand-climbed holds that light up and emit posts) + physical chalk-dust particles as texture and as the transition + a camera travelling a giant wall to a pull-back calendar reveal, with condensed kinetic type spanning the width
dna.opening: a night-lit teal climbing wall fills the frame, a chalked hand grabs magenta holds one by one, each grab throwing a chalk puff, under the hook "One climbing session. Thirty posts." in huge condensed type
dna.bigMoment: after a held breath the camera whips back to the whole wall: thirty numbered holds ignite from the floor to the top-out in a wave of chalk while a day counter runs to 30, the route becomes a month of posts
dna.ground: teal-black climbing wall with a T-nut dot grid and panel seams, a moving sulphur light beam, chalk dust, magenta and sulphur light leaks, vignette and light grain
dna.music: driving indie-electronic with a taut bass pulse and hand claps, a held breath, a bright lift on the ignite wave and a tight resolve, about 100 BPM
